nodes.name: Receive simulator event
nodes.notes: Production URL /webhook/telemetry. Answers 200 immediately so the simulator is never slowed down.

nodes.name: Store and score in monitor
nodes.notes: Duplicates are stored once by the monitor (event_id is the primary key). Retries 5 times, 3 seconds apart, which covers a short database restart. Failed runs stay in n8n's execution list and can be retried from there.
